native_fields.rules_primary: If Brandon Miller records 2+ assists in the Washington vs Charlotte Pro Basketball game originally scheduled for Oct 26, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
native_fields.rules_secondary:
Note: If a player is inactive, or active but never takes the court, the market settles to a fair price. Once a player enters the game the market settles based on the player's assists recorded.

If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is cancelled or not started within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start, all markets will resolve to a fair price.
